response.overview: Freak is a psychological horror/thriller about a struggling videographer named Adam who accepts a mysterious job filming a man living alone in a remote house in the woods The man, Josh claims he wants to record a video for his unborn child, but as the day goes on, his behavior becomes increasingly bizarre, unsettling, and unpredictable. Adam begins to realize that something is seriously wrong, and what seemed like an easy job slowly turns into a terrifying fight to escape someone he can't understand.
response.title: Freak
